Sub-national coverage maps

Source: R/page-national_inequality--mapping.R
subnational_mapping_ui.Rd

The maps of the national inequality page: one card with a tab for each of the app's default indicators (cd_default_indicator_set()) and a Custom tab for any other analysis indicator. A tab draws maps of the indicator's coverage in each admin level 1 area, with the denominator selected for the indicator, for the years chosen for mapping (cache()$mapping_years). It reads the dataset's get_filtered_mapping_data(), which joins the admin level 1 coverage to the map through the dataset's map mapping. The piece has no filters of its own: the page gives it the colour palette and the tab to show.

Usage

subnational_mapping_ui(id, i18n)

subnational_mapping_server(
  id,
  cache,
  i18n,
  palette,
  selected_tab,
  active = reactive(TRUE)
)

Arguments

id

The module's id.

i18n

The app's translator (a shiny.i18n translator), used for every label.

cache

A reactive that returns the dataset, a CacheConnection.

palette

A reactive that returns the name of the maps' colour palette (for example "Greens").

selected_tab

A reactive that returns the key of the tab to show, or NULL to leave the tabs as they are. When its value changes, the maps switch to that tab.

active

A reactive that is TRUE once the page has been opened with data loaded. The maps do no work before that.

Value

subnational_mapping_ui() returns the card's UI as Shiny tags. subnational_mapping_server() returns a reactive that holds the key of the tab shown: an indicator's name, or "custom".

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# the maps below the inequality charts, showing the tab the charts show
my_page_ui <- function(id, i18n) {
  ns <- NS(id)
  cd_page_ui(id, i18n,
    inequality_ui(ns("inequality"), i18n),
    cd_map_options(cd_palette_chip(ns("palette"), i18n)),
    subnational_mapping_ui(ns("map"), i18n)
  )
}
my_page_server <- function(id, cache, i18n, active = reactive(TRUE)) {
  moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {
    selected_tab <- inequality_server("inequality", cache, i18n, reactive("adminlevel_1"), active = active)
    subnational_mapping_server("map", cache, i18n, reactive(input$palette), selected_tab, active = active)
  })
}
} # }
